DLC2312:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Behind every person who dazzles us with their achievements, there are always others quietly working to support them.」

DLC2312:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Shift your perspective just a little, and you may be amazed by strengths you never noticed before...」

DLC2312:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I'm about to tell takes place just after $$スズネ$$ was abducted.」

DLC2312:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There, we were shown just how deep the talents of $c run.」

DLC2312:3:t_2:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Major $$コンロイ$$... Report on the situation.」

DLC2312:3:t_2:5.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「As expected, the commander of our target, $$ターミナル・ベース$$, appears to be $$サルディアス・アクス$$.」

DLC2312:3:t_2:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$バルビエル$$'s adjutant... If we defeat him, we can get information about $$スズネ$$...」

DLC2312:3:t_2:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Above all, taking that base would sever the command structure of $$サイデリアル$$'s forces deployed in the Pacific on $$翠の地球$$.」

DLC2312:3:t_2:8.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「With that in mind, we should capture it before splitting our forces.」

DLC2312:3:t_2:9.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Its fighting strength is not particularly significant. The problem is that the base also serves as a prisoner detention facility.」

DLC2312:3:t_2:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「Like $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$ on $$蒼の地球$$...」

DLC2312:3:t_2:11.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$サルディアス・アクス$$ is a far more tactically capable commander than someone like $$ギルター$$.」

DLC2312:3:t_2:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If it serves his strategy, that man will use inhumane tactics without hesitation.」

DLC2312:3:t_2:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Because he never lets his emotions or personal tastes take priority, he's incomparably more dangerous than $$バルビエル$$ and his sort.」

DLC2312:3:t_2:14.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So depending on the situation, he might use the entire town's population as hostages...」

DLC2312:3:t_2:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To take the base, we must first evacuate the residents.」

DLC2312:3:t_2:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then our only option is to infiltrate and break their defenses down from the inside.」

DLC2312:3:t_2:17.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「But they're watching our movements. Naturally, they'll be on guard against that.」

DLC2312:3:t_2:18.en:
$$ブライト$$
「One wrong move, and our infiltration team would just walk into an enemy trap...」

DLC2312:3:t_2:20.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Do you have an idea, $$佐伯$$?」

DLC2312:3:t_2:21.en:
$$佐伯$$
「What if we sent in an infiltration team... that isn't an infiltration team?」

DLC2312:3:t_2:23.en:
$$オットー$$
「What are you talking about?」

DLC2312:3:t_2:24.en:
$$佐伯$$
「I think that very confusion will be the key to the operation's success.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Thank you for your hard work, Section Chief $$大杉$$.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:5.en:
$$大杉$$
「Not at all. We're members of $c, too.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:6.en:
$$横沢$$
「We want to do something for the Earth just as much as everyone else.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:7.en:
$$谷川$$
「Though that was quite a bit of service outside our job descriptions.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:8.en:
$$中原$$
「You'll spoil the moment if you say that, $$谷川$$.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:9.en:
$$イアン$$
「Still, it's true that doing work we're not used to has left us a little tired.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:10.en:
$$チェーン$$
「Yes... I feel like we've earned a little reward.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All right, $$チェーン$$. I'll help with today's maintenance, too.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:13.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then we'll give the support crew a hand.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:14.en:
$$アルト$$
「Leave the cooking to me, $$甲児$$ and $$ジョニー$$.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:15.en:
$$ミコット$$
「Maybe I'll have $$バナージ$$ do the ironing.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If you're all right with me doing it.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:18.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「We can't leave everything to $$シン$$ and $$バナージ$$. I'll do it, too.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:19.en:
$$赤木$$
「$$大山$$. As head of the support crew, please supervise us.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:20.en:
$$大山$$
「Understood. Then let me say something I've always wanted to say.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:21.en:
$$大山$$
「From the support crew chief to all personnel! We will now commence a thorough cleaning and prepare dinner!」

DLC2312:3:t_3:23.en:
$$大山$$
「All members of the $c mobile force, follow the instructions of the person in charge of each task and begin work!」

DLC2312:3:t_3:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...The support and maintenance crews... They rarely stand in the spotlight, but their determination to protect peace is every bit as strong as the mobile force's.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Incidentally, I, your dimensional merchant, was never called up for this mission.」

DLC2312:3:t_3:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sure that's because I'm the most secret of secret weapons. I shall choose not to think I was simply left out...」

DLC2312:3:t_3:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone... Until we meet again.」

DLC2312:4:t_000:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Another peaceful day. Excellent, excellent. How is security?」

DLC2312:4:t_000:1.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Sir! We've registered the $c mobile force's data with the $$デイモーン$$s and are maintaining our watch.」

DLC2312:4:t_000:2.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「In addition, we're using human eyes to double-check for infiltrators who aren't in the database.」

DLC2312:4:t_000:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Excellent. I'll be rejoining the boss tomorrow, so I'll be counting on you after that.」

DLC2312:4:t_000:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「The entire town is practically our prisoner. Just make sure everything stays nice and peaceful.」

DLC2312:4:t_000:8.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
（For a moment, the surveillance image seemed to flicker, but... I probably imagined it...）

DLC2312:4:t_000:10.en:
$$イアン$$
「Now all the surveillance cameras in town will keep picking up dummy footage.」

DLC2312:4:t_000:11.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Every mechanic in $c worked on this little trick. They're not going to spot it easily.」

DLC2312:4:t_000:12.en:
$$チェーン$$
「Then let's stay here at the relay station and handle control of the infrastructure.」

DLC2312:4:t_000:14.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Whoops, here comes a security patrol!」

DLC2312:4:t_000:16.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Some of us mechanics know how to fight, too!!」

DLC2312:4:t_001:1.en:
$$イアン$$
「$$セイミー$$, $$ピニオン$$! Hold that robot soldier down!!」

DLC2312:4:t_001:2.en:
$$チェーン$$
「Let's modify this one so it keeps sending an all-clear report.」

DLC2312:4:t_001:3.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Everything's going according to plan so far... Let's leave the rest to the other team.」

DLC2312:4:t_001:4.en:
$$横沢$$
「...Team M reports that preparations are complete.」

DLC2312:4:t_001:6.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「What happens when a spark reaches citizens constantly plagued by fear and frustration...? They're about to find out firsthand.」

DLC2312:4:t_002:2.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「It might be an infiltrator! Which way did the criminal go?!」

DLC2312:4:t_002:3.en:
$$ミコット$$
「O-over there! To the left!」

review.context: The commanders plan to free Terminal Base's captive population by deploying the ordinary support and maintenance staff. The operation disables surveillance and begins a diversion.
decisions: Saeki's paradox refers to sending unlisted support personnel rather than the expected combat infiltrators.
The post-mission cleaning scene is the mobile force repaying the support crew, including restoring the direction of the requests.
